description: Figure 5 shows a bar chart comparing the accuracy of the Vanilla model and the HCL model on different datasets. The x-axis represents the datasets, and the y-axis represents the accuracy percentage. The Vanilla model has higher accuracy on the AddSub dataset, while the HCL model has higher accuracy on the MixMul dataset. The HCL model also has higher accuracy on the MixAll dataset compared to the Vanilla model.
